name: job-finder
description: Set up job-finder for a new person from Cowork (job-finder-setup), then run the weekly job application loop: tailor, fact-check, render and fill the top pending roles, stopping before submit (job-apply-weekly). Bump the version on every change that must reach Cowork; the version shown in Cowork's plugin list is the only way to see whether the installed snapshot matches the repo.
